# Atypical Antipsychotic Agents

**Authors:** Keith Willner, Sarayu Vasan, Preeti Patel, Sara Abdijadid

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

This activity offers an exploration of atypical antipsychotics, the preferred pharmacological intervention for acute psychoses. Distinguished by their distinct clinical profile from conventional antipsychotics, atypical antipsychotics have emerged as frontline agents in managing psychosis. This program delineates their indications, mechanism of action, administration guidelines, potential adverse effects, contraindications, toxicology considerations, and monitoring protocols. By understanding atypical antipsychotics, healthcare practitioners gain the expertise to navigate treatment complexities adeptly, thus ensuring optimal patient care and minimizing adverse reactions. Through evidence-based insights, this initiative empowers healthcare professionals to cultivate interprofessional collaboration, fostering improved treatment outcomes and bolstering patient well-being in psychiatric disorders treated with atypical antipsychotics.
